newsitem.title: USA: AmerUs Life sets initial $0.10/shr payout.
newsitem.headline: AmerUs Life sets initial $0.10/shr payout.

text.p: AmerUs Life Holdings Inc said Friday its board of directors declared an intitial quarterly dividend of $0.10 a share.
The dividend is payable May 30 to stockholders of record May 16, the insurance holding company said.

"The initiation of a quarterly dividend at an annualized rate of $0.40 per share reflects not only our record operating earnings in 1996, but also our confidence in our growth prospects," Roger Brooks, chairman, president and chief executive officer, said in a news release.
